Do you enjoy turning complex process and operational data into meaningful improvements? And would you like to help build a more connected, data-driven way of monitoring and improving global processes?

As our new Senior Specialist, Global Process Monitoring, you will help make the health of our global Order-to-Cash processes visible, measurable and actionable. You will work across functions and regions to identify systemic issues, uncover their root causes and ensure that sustainable improvements are implemented at the source, rather than repeatedly resolving the same symptoms.

Your role

Joining Global Operations Excellence, you will take ownership of global process monitoring, bringing together insights from local process-monitoring teams across our Distribution Centres.

Through regular end-to-end monitoring, you will transform process and ERP data into early warnings, actionable insights and clear improvement priorities. With a global overview of process performance and bottlenecks, you will help ensure that the right issues receive the right attention from Distribution Centres, Global Process Owners and other key stakeholders.

You will work closely with colleagues across  Operations, Application Management, Master Data, Global Business Services, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology and Finance. You will also help identify opportunities where analytics, data and AI-enabled capabilities can improve operational performance and create measurable business value.

Key responsibilities

• 
Own the global process-monitoring approach, incorporating insights from local teams across our Distribution Centres.

• 
Proactively identify issues and improvement opportunities throughout the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process.

• 
Turn process and ERP data into early warnings, root-cause insights and actionable recommendations.

• 
Govern and prioritise the global issue-resolution backlog together with Global Process Owners and Distribution Centres.

• 
Drive alignment across regions, Distribution Centres and global functions to support continuous process improvement.

• 
Identify  opportunities for AI-enabled process optimisation.

• 
Build strong partnerships across Operations, Data & Analytics, and Digital & Technology.

• 
Support the adoption of increasingly data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working across  Operation.

What you bring

You combine a strong analytical mindset with the ability to influence, collaborate and create progress across functions. You are comfortable navigating complex processes and can translate data and operational insights into clear priorities and sustainable improvements.

We imagine that you have:

• 
Approximately three to five years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• 
Experience within analytics, performance management, process improvement or operational excellence.

• 
A strong understanding of KPI frameworks, business-performance measurement and data-driven decision-making.

• 
Experience working across multiple operational functions, ideally within an international or global environment.

• 
The ability to influence stakeholders and establish alignment across teams and functions.

• 
An understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities.

• 
A bachelor’s degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Analytics, Data Management or a related discipline.

• 
Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Your personal qualities

You are curious, proactive and motivated by solving problems at their source. You approach challenges with a strategic and analytical mindset, while remaining collaborative and approachable in your work with others.

You communicate complex topics clearly, make considered decisions and maintain momentum across different stakeholder groups. Most importantly, you bring a continuous-improvement mindset and a genuine interest in how data, technology and AI can contribute to better business processes

Additional information

• Global Career Band 5A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive.

Delivering software excellence and pushing the limits of technology to make some of the world’s best hearing aids is what we do in Demant.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with broad competencies who wants to develop and strengthen our Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL).

You will be deep down the software stack in a crucial and complex part of our software eco system.

Development, defect support and platform improvements

Our HAL platform connects to hearing aids, apps, fitting software and sophisticated internal tools. Seamless Bluetooth solutions and connectivity are crucial for the end-users to have great experience with our hearing aids.

We embrace agile software development and use Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and releases the HAL platform 2-4 times per year. The backlog of features and enablers are executed by priority.

The features are platform support of audiological or end user features. The enablers are typically platform improvements for the future and general internal improvements that can be either specific or of an exploratory nature.

What you will do

Your job can be divided into these three main areas:

• 
Most of your daily life is analyzing, designing, coding, testing and integrating our platform, always done with a broad mindset. Analyzing logs and unraveling mysteries is a key activity in the role and team.

• 
With an ever-changing Bluetooth environment and incoming defects there will be adjustments, which you must react fast to as part of the team. You will also act as problem solver for other teams consuming HAL.

• 
Lastly, you will be part of simplifying HAL to make the solutions more effective, maintainable and secure. In collaboration with the team, you will identify improvements and come up with suggestions for how these should be implemented.

We need everybody in the team to be on top of technology to keep on improving and providing best-in-class solutions. To support this, we have a monthly learning day for the team to acquire relevant knowledge either individually or on a team base.

We invest in and take advantage of AI, that is part of our development environment and tooling.

Teamwork, teamwork, teamwork

Part of your team consists of six Software Developers, two Test Developers, a Product Owner and a Scrum Master. They are all very experienced and enthusiastic about their jobs.

We encourage and strive for T-shaping, meaning that it is healthy that we share the responsibilities and grow mutual skills between developers and test developers.

Scrum is used as the basic way of working and encourages collaboration, sparring and sharing of thoughts and enables the best possible solutions.

It is important that you can collaborate with others and see the gain of it, rather than just working on your own. We hope that you, with your energy and enthusiasm, will contribute and encourage cooperation.

Your manager is a “servant leader” and will support your needs and development in our trust-based culture.

We believe in the good life

In Demant we trust and value professionalism, experience, and commitment. We recognize that to bring energy and inspiration to work, you need to re-energize and spend time with family, friends, and hobbies in a healthy work life balance.

To ensure the good life we offer good breakfast and lunch in our canteen, free fitness room including weekly spinning and yoga sessions, massage offer, no child’s first sick day meaning you can stay home with your child as long as the child is not feeling well and the possibility to work from home up to two days per week. Just to mention some of the things.

Your profile

• To candidate for this job, you need to be Senior Software Developer with minimum 8 years of experience. You have experience with hardware abstraction layers either as a provider or consumer.

• You are proficient in .NET and #C and have experience with Bluetooth Low Energy and/or have made apps; IOS, Android or MAUI, and are able to grasp, navigate and make a difference in a large eco-system of software and hardware.

• You like to understand how things work and to untangle complex issues in the complex HAL world.

• It will be nice but is not required if you have experience from pharma / medico or other regulated industries and know how it impact our work.

• Other people will say you have a high focus on quality and testing at all levels and that you enjoy the respect of others as a team player, where you seek the optimal solution through a constructive dialogue.

• It is required that you work on-site Smørum from 1st of January 2027 and no later than 1st of February 2027.

Interested in our exciting position? - Deadline is the 8th of November 2026.

Submit CV and a short, focused motivation in English reflecting the profile above.

We expect to hold the 1st interview on the 16th and 18th of November, and the 2nd interview on the 23rd and 24th of November.

Applications are only accepted via our online platform. We do not respond to inquiries from external suppliers.

For more information, please contact Ken Eberhardt Nielsen, Senior Manager, Software Solutions: kehb@demant.com.

Digital Transformation Lead

Workplace technology shapes the daily experience of everyone who works at Danske Bank. As Digital Transformation Lead, you will connect business needs, technology decisions, and operational realities to help build a workplace that works well for all employees and teams. This is a role where strategic thinking and practical detail go hand in hand.

What you will be doing

You will join a diverse team of seven people within the Center of Excellence in Group Workplace Management, collectively responsible for workplace management strategy, the digital roadmap, workplace insights, and performance management. The team works across a broad stakeholder landscape that includes employees across Danske Bank, external technology suppliers, facility management vendors, application owners, and operational teams. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a practical approach to improvement are central to how the team operates. More specifically, you will:

• Develop and maintain the workplace technology landscape and digital implementation roadmap

• Act as business-side owner for solutions covering meeting management, visitor management, smart storage, and hospitality

• Prepare recommendations to invest in, retain, standardise, consolidate, replace, or decommission technologies

• Identify technology-related compliance gaps and coordinate the necessary business input to address them

• Provide business-side input to technology budgets, licensing requirements, hardware needs, and supplier discussions

• Develop user guides, administrator guides, intranet content, and operational handover material

• Facilitate workshops, define business processes and user journeys, and support testing and implementation

About you

• Experience translating business and operational needs into clear requirements

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with structured coordination and follow-up

• Experience working with technology portfolios, digital solutions, or implementation roadmaps

• Comfortable facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders with varying priorities

• Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics

• Builds trusted relationships and works effectively across teams, functions, and countries

A background in business analysis, technology portfolio management, product ownership, or digital workplace solutions would be advantageous. We value varied experience and welcome candidates who bring a different perspective to this work.

What we offer you

This role gives you direct involvement in shaping the workplace experience for employees, visitors, and operational teams across Danske Bank. You will work in a hybrid setup, typically spending three to four days per week in the office, enabling close collaboration and knowledge sharing with your team. There is genuine scope for learning across both strategic and operational dimensions of workplace technology.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to learn more about this position, please reach out to Andrea Toft, Head of Center of Excellence, Group Workplace Management, at andto@danskebank.dk. Please submit your application by 6 November 2026.

Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Senior Consultant, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

We are looking for highly motivated and ambitious Senior Consultant who can contribute across a broad spectrum of projects — including implementation, optimization, and ongoing consulting for the commercial area (SFE,CRM). The role is open to candidates with either a technical background or a business consulting mindset, as long as you bring curiosity, structure, and a collaborative spirit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, helping clients translate business goals into scalable, system-supported solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• Lead workstreams or small teams on client projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment.

• Conduct process assessments and define future-state operating models across commercial functions.

• Translate business needs into system requirements and support end-to-end implementation of platforms.

• Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and manage documentation (e.g., project plans, RAID logs).

• Support IT and commercial strategy definition, including CRM optimization and system integration.

• Drive change management activities, including training design, stakeholder engagement, and adoption planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, bringing structure, insight, and industry best practices.

• Engage in Sales processes by taking part in RfP responses and delivering presentations.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience ideally in project-based roles within consulting or the life sciences sector implementing solutions for the commercial area.

• Required consulting and hands-on experience in Salesforce, Veeva, and other CRM systems (certifications in Salesforce and Veeva will be a plus). Technical understanding is a plus, especially for projects involving IT collaboration.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in English.

• Ability to create compelling presentations and confidently present to diverse audiences.

• Proactive mindset with a “can-do” attitude and eagerness to learn.

• Comfortable working in agile teams and remote environments.

• Project Management and Agile methodologies experience (certifications on Agile, PMP... will be a plus).

• Experience facilitating workshops and driving client expectations into sustainable solutions.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage change at scale.

• It will be a plus if you have these additional capabilities:

• Experience working in global or regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance).

• Prior consulting experience — especially in top-tier consulting firms — is valued but not required.

• Exposure to enterprise platform rollouts or system integration projects.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

• Experience contributing to Salesforce Effectiveness initiatives, including CRM usage optimization, sales process alignment, and support for user adoption strategies.

• Interest in emerging technologies and AI.

This position is offered in Denmark.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Senior Manager, Group Development & Strategy

Help shape Coloplast’s growth agenda by sourcing, evaluating and executing strategic transactions across our global business.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager to join Group Development & Strategy at our headquarters in Humlebæk. The role will have a primary focus on M&A while also contributing to selected enterprise strategy projects. You will help develop Coloplast’s M&A agenda, build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities across our business segments, support the M&A Director on key priorities and independently lead selected projects.

The transaction scope spans acquisitions, divestments, minority equity investments and strategic partnerships, as well as integration planning. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to senior leaders, business segments, global functions and external advisers.

Welcome to Group Development & Strategy

You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Together, we work across group strategy, strategic projects, transactions and post-merger integration, collaborating closely with Executive Leadership and teams across the organisation. You will become part of a distinctive performance culture focused on working together to achieve the best results.

Your key responsibilities includes

•    Support the development of the enterprise M&A strategy and strategic priorities across our business units

•    Source opportunities and maintain the pipeline across acquisitions, divestments, equity investments and partnerships

•    Assess potential targets, including strategic fit, value and key risks, in collaboration with internal stakeholders

•    Support the M&A Director on key transactions and independently lead selected processes

•    Prepare financial models, valuations and business cases

•    Coordinate due diligence across relevant functions

•    Manage relationships with targets, owners and external advisers

•    Support integration planning and the handover to the business

•    Prepare proposals and recommendations for senior management and other internal stakeholders

•    Monitor market, competitor and transaction trends relevant to Coloplast

•    Support on selected enterprise strategy and integration projects

What we expect from you:

•    A relevant commercial master’s degree or MBA

•    5–6 years of experience within M&A and ideally with strategic projects

•    Experience from top-tier consulting, investment banking and/or private equity

•    Strong financial and business modelling skills and hands-on M&A execution capabilities

•    Experience across all phases of a transaction

•    Experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

•    Fluent written and spoken English

•    Experience working in an international environment

•    Experience from healthcare or medical devices industry is an advantage, but not a requirement

How you work

You are intellectually curious and comfortable moving between the big picture and detailed analysis. You create momentum in ambiguous situations, challenge constructively and know when to involve others. You build trust across functions and geographies, remain composed under pressure and balance analytical thoroughness with the pace required in live transactions.

Role details

Location: Humlebæk, Denmark

Team: Group Development & Strategy

Reports to: Group Development & Strategy Director

Travel: Some international travel should be expected, particularly during active transactions.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and  trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Be a part of the data revolution in sports!

This is a great opportunity to join our growing Data Science and BI developer team. Our team is responsible for the development and operations of both our internal and customer-facing reporting and dashboard solutions, as well as our data science and machine learning products. We are focused on making our rich tracking data more actionable to customers as well as supporting our internal product development and operations with useful insights. We also use our data to develop data science and machine learning solutions that enhance our product experiences. In collaboration with our cutting-edge radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• Reporting for environmental variations between stadium tracking locations based on athlete performance models and statistical analysis

• Dashboards for trends and detecting outliers in radar tracking and computer vision diagnostics across thousands of remote devices

• Translating ball tracking metrics into coaching-orientated measures to help amateur athletes improve their performance

• Supervised learning models to suggest both practice and gameplay recommendations to make our sophisticated products easier to use

• Vision-based person detection combined with predicting the position they play on the field for game strategy

Your Profile

You have hands-on experience working with data day to day in SQL and python, from the fundamentals of loading, ETL, and pipeline automation to answering ad-hoc questions from the business and operations teams. You have experience developing reports and dashboards to address the questions that are reoccurring. You are familiar with using a developer tool stack and operating in a scrum team. You also have experience using data science modelling techniques to derive next-level insight from data, as well as an appreciation for running machine learning in production. Your focus is on the practical outcome and value to the business of using data to inform everything we do. You like working in an international team across many cultures. You like sports.

Responsibilities

• Develop internal and customer-facing BI reports and dashboards

• Use dimensional modelling to develop database schemas and semantic layers

• Manage data warehouse data pipeline automation rules, ensure smooth operations

• Work with our Data Engineers to acquire and prepare working data, initial data cleaning, statistical analysis, and mining

• Interface with product owners, operations, and developers to refine requirements

• Identify and perform data science model selection, feature engineering, and tuning, develop an experiment based and evaluation workflow, package for production

Job requirements

• A strong educational background where coursework required heavy use of data and a scientific or engineering based workflows

• Experience with data processing, preparation, cleansing, and mining, in SQL and Python

• Experience developing dashboards and reports in a BI toolset

• Experience with applying data science and machine learning methods and move across a variety of unsupervised and supervised approaches, experience with NumPy, pandas, sci-kit learn

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative, and proactive in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables.

The Office

Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.

Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Machine Learning Researcher at Alipes.

At Alipes, we have been the market leader in automating the financial markets since we started back in 2008, shaping a fully automatic natural language processing system for reading and interpreting financial news.

To accomplish our mission of being the best at what we do, we understand the importance of elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels. Your work will involve leading the efforts in creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to seamlessly turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the financial markets.

In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

• Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks

• Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines

• Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.

You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.

About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done. We are a tight-knit modeling team with fourteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities – eleven PhD’s and three MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and understand that a seemingly trivial change can actually require a lot of work, and vice versa.

About you

• Fluency within mathematics and statistics.

• Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.

• Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.

• Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.

• A scientific and inquisitive mind.

Nice to have

• Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.

• Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.

• Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.

• PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.

What we can offer you

• Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• A modern, harbour front office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and, in lieu of providing a cover letter, concisely answer the questions on the application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

Should you have questions about the role that you would like clarified before applying, you're welcome to send an email to quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please note that applications should not be sent to the email address but rather via the job link.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Energy as a Technical Project Manager and lead the technical execution of a large-scale high-voltage substation project: a 400 kV AC substation with GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), Control & Protection systems, SCADA, telecommunications and auxiliary systems, which will connect future offshore wind. As the technical authority in the project organization, you report to the overall project manager and coordinate all technical disciplines on the Danish part of this flagship infrastructure project in Denmark, which runs until 2034. From design through installation and commissioning, you represent the technical side in meetings with the customer and a large international project organization, making a significant impact on the future of power transmission and the energy transition.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading the technical execution of a complex high-voltage substation project from design through installation and commissioning

• Coordinating a multidisciplinary team of 7-10 discipline leads, scope managers and engineering specialists, and ensuring each discipline delivers its commitments on time and to the required quality

• Driving technical planning and engineering schedules with a clear work breakdown, critical path and intermediate milestones, aligning interfaces and dependencies between work packages and monitoring progress against schedules and budgets

• Acting as the primary escalation point for technical challenges, managing technical risks and mitigation plans, and presenting technical solutions to the customer side by side with the overall project manager

• Participating in customer meetings and technical workshops, and collaborating closely with project management, site management, procurement, construction and commissioning teams

• Ensuring compliance with standards, regulations, employer requirements and contractual technical obligations, leading requirement management and traceability, and supporting design reviews

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline

• Minimum 5 years of experience leading technical teams and coordinating engineering disciplines within power transmission, substations or large infrastructure projects, for example as a technical project manager or senior technical lead

• Strong understanding of high-voltage substations, especially GIS and Control and Protection systems, as well as AIS, SCADA, communication and auxiliary systems

• Strong knowledge of engineering standards, specifications and requirement management, and experience working directly with customers, contractors and external stakeholders

• A structured, proactive and results-oriented leader who is confident in large customer-facing meetings and technical negotiations, and builds strong relationships across disciplines and organizations

• Fluent English, Danish is considered an advantage

About the Team

This position is part of our Substation engineering department in Denmark, which consists of four engineering teams and a number of specialists reporting directly to the Head of Engineering. In the project, the Technical Project Manager is supported by work package managers and experts within each technical discipline.

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

The company

The banking and digital marketing landscape is shifting fast, and Danske Bank is moving with it. As a Senior CRM Analyst, you will shape how we reach over 200,000 small and mid-sized corporate customers across the Nordic countries through data-driven campaigns. You will apply your Adobe competencies to turn complex data into targeted campaigns and customer journeys. You will gain real ownership of your work, collaborate across borders, and grow your skills in a team that values curiosity and shared learning.

What you will be doing

You will join the BC Analytics & Insights team, a Nordic group working at the intersection of data, marketing, and commercial strategy. The team operates in an agile sprint environment and works closely with Marketing and Commercial Planners across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland. Your work will directly support the Business Customers unit, helping ensure that campaigns and customer journeys are built on solid, well-structured data and audience logic.

More specifically, you will:

• Translate campaign briefs into technical campaign flows and audience logic in Adobe

• Build and process complex target groups for campaigns, customer journeys, and customer signals

• Support colleagues in Adobe usage as Danske Bank transitions from SAS360 to Adobe

• Collaborate with Marketing and Commercial Planners to identify relevant target groups

• Keep stakeholders informed on progress and ensure alignment with commercial strategies

About you

• Experience working with Adobe MarTech solutions

• Solid SQL skills and a structured, data-driven approach

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Commercial mindset with the ability to translate business needs into data logic

• Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks

• Embrace change and integrate AI into your daily work

• Curious, open to questioning existing approaches, and willing to share knowledge with colleagues

Experience with B2B customers or the banking industry is a plus, as is familiarity with platform migration projects or working in agile teams with remote members across different countries.

What we offer you

This role is based in Denmark and follows a hybrid working model, with three to four days per week in the office to support collaboration and knowledge sharing. You will have genuine autonomy in your work and access to continuous learning opportunities that support your long-term development. The team is skilled, collaborative, and committed to doing good work together.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we welcome your application. Feel free to reach out to Louise Nørsten, Head of Analytics & Pricing, at lnrs@danskebank.dk if you have any questions before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as.

We look forward to hearing from you!
